name: Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda
education: B.A., LL.B. Educated at St. Xaviers School, Patna, Patna College, Patna University and Himachal Pradesh University, Shimla
permanent_address: Village Vijaypur, P.O., Auhar, Tehsil Jhandutta, Distt. Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh. 174024
social_activities: Won various debating competitions in Hindi and English
hobbies: Was President, Olympic Association, Himachal Pradesh, 2008-2012; President, (i) Himachal Handball Association and (ii) Himachal Archery Association; Ex-Member Trustee, Special Olympics Bharat
countries_visited: U.S.A., as Member of Indian delegation to study the American Presidential Elections, 1992-93; Qatar, to attend a seminar on 'Enriching the Middle East's Economic Future', March 2008; Australia, to study the health care system; China, to attend 26th Executive Committee Meeting of Partners in Population and Development (PPD), 26 - 27 March 2015; Switzerland, to attend Commonwealth Health Ministers Meeting (CHMM) as the President of the 68th World Health Assembly (WHA), 16 - 26 May 2015; Maldives, to attend Golden Jubilee Celebration of Independence of Maldives as the Special Envoy of Prime Minister, 26 - 27 July 2015; Bangladesh, to attend the Annual Board Meeting of Partners in Population and Development, 18 - 21 November 2015; Indonesia, to attend the inaugural function and Plenary of the International Conference on Family Planning (ICFP) : Family Planning and New Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), 25 - 26 January 2016; Japan, to attend the Asian Health Ministers meet on Antimicrobial Resistance, 16 April 2016; Sri Lanka, to attend the 69th Session of the WHO Regional Committee (RC) for South East Asia Region, 5-9 Sept. 2016; Germany, to attend the 29th Stop TB Partnership Coordination Board and G 20 Health Ministers’ Meeting, 18-20 May 2017; Switzerland, to attend the 70th WHA/CHMM and BRICS Health Ministers Meeting 21-25 May 2017 and 71st WHA and CHMM, 20-23 May 2018; China, to attend the 7th BRICS Health Ministers’ Meeting, 5-7 July 2017; Australia, to attend the International Digital Health Symposium, 19-21 February 2018; Russia, to attend the Global Ministerial Conference on ‘Ending TB’, 16-17 November 2017; South Africa, to attend the 8th BRICS Health Ministers’ Meeting, 18-20 July 2018 and U.S.A., to attend the UN-HLM on TB and NCD, 25-28 September 2018; Canada, Costa Rica, Greece, U.K. and Turkey in other capacities
other_information: Was inspired by the J.P. Movement to join the Chhatra Sangharsh Samiti; associated with the A.B.V.P., B.J.Y.M. and the B.J.P. in different capacities; detained for 45 days for leading a campaign for up-grading schools; organised, Rashtriya Sangarsh Morcha against corruption, 1987; National General Secretary, B.J.P., May 2010 -Nov. 2014; Secretary, B.J.P. Parliamentary Board and Central Election Committee, Sept. 2014-2019; National Working President, 2019-2020; National President, B.J.P. since January 2020
